name: v5.7.0
body:
## Highlights

- **Built with Go 1.27.4**, which rejects TLS certificate chains through the distrusted eMudhra intermediate CAs
  ([GO-2026-6809](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6809)), so Scorecard no longer connects to servers that present them
  ([#5364](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/5364)). by @justaugustus in #5460
- **GitHub immutable releases count** for Signed-Releases and Pinned-Dependencies. See [Score changes](#score-changes).

### `scorecard mcp`: Scorecard in your AI assistant (experimental)

`scorecard mcp` runs a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, so assistants such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop and VS
Code can answer questions about a project's security practices from Scorecard data. Ask for a repository's score, the
details and remediation for one check, or a comparison of several repositories, and the answer comes from Scorecard's
published results, with the commit, scan date and Scorecard version it reflects.

It needs no token and no extra install: it's part of the `scorecard` binary and talks to the client over stdio. For
Claude Code:

```sh
claude mcp add scorecard --scope user -- scorecard mcp
```

It covers repositories that publish their results, such as those using scorecard-action or included in the weekly public
scan. It doesn't run new scans yet. Setup for other clients is in the [README](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard#scorecard-mcp-server) and [docs/mcp.md](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/main/docs/mcp.md).
by @justaugustus in #5402, with fixes listed under General.

### OSPS Baseline conformance mode (experimental)

Scorecard can now report a repository's results against [OSPS Baseline](https://baseline.openssf.org) requirements
instead of check scores. Choose a maturity level and an output format:

```sh
scorecard --repo=github.com/ossf/scorecard \
  --catalog=osps-baseline --profile=maturity-1 --format=json
```

Each requirement gets PASS, FAIL, UNKNOWN, NOT_APPLICABLE or NEEDS_REVIEW, with the probe findings behind it as
evidence. Requirements Scorecard doesn't map yet are listed as not evaluated. This first release evaluates the
primary-branch protection requirements, OSPS-AC-03.01 and OSPS-AC-03.02. `--format=gemara` writes a
[Gemara](https://github.com/gemaraproj/gemara) Evaluation Log for compliance tooling. Runs without `--catalog` are
unchanged. The options and output may change, and every run says so on standard error. Details are in
[docs/conformance.md](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/blob/main/docs/conformance.md). by @justaugustus in #5449

## Action Required

- **Scorecard exits 1 again when a repository scan or writing results fails.** v5.4.0 through v5.6.0 exited 0 in these
  cases, for example a missing `--local` path, an unwritable `--output` file, or an unknown probe. v5.3.0 and earlier
  exited 1. Remaining repositories are still scanned, and low or inconclusive scores still exit 0. by @JamieMagee in
  #5319
- **`scorecard serve` listens on 127.0.0.1 by default and no longer sends CORS headers.** To reach it from other hosts,
  including through a published container port, pass `--listen`, for example `scorecard serve --listen 0.0.0.0`.
  `scorecard serve --help` now says the server has no authentication or rate limiting. by @justaugustus in #5378 and
  #5337
- **`scorecard-attestor` has been removed**, along with its `attestor/` Go packages. by @justaugustus in #5371
- **GitLab: `GITLAB_AUTH_TOKEN` is sent only to the instance in `GL_HOST`**, or to GitLab.com when `GL_HOST` is unset.
  Other GitLab instances are scanned without the token, so set `GL_HOST` to scan private projects on a self-managed
  instance. GitLab repository URLs must use https. by @justaugustus in 8517fc17
- **Library users: Go 1.27.4 or later is required** (`go` directive raised from 1.26.8). by @justaugustus in #5475
- **Library users: `clients.RepoClient` has a new method, `IsReleaseImmutable`.** Implementations outside Scorecard must
  add it. by @jessehouwing in #5248

## Security

v5.7.0 fixes the issues in these advisories.

- [GHSA-vphr-r3r5-mmfv]: git file mode no longer reads files outside the clone through symlinks, and skips symlinks it
  can't read instead of failing the check. by @justaugustus in #5377
- [GHSA-6r4f-r463-fh56]: `scorecard serve` no longer allows cross-origin reads. by @justaugustus in #5378
- [GHSA-f6hq-fqq8-mjq8]: `GITLAB_AUTH_TOKEN` goes only to the configured GitLab instance. by @justaugustus in 8517fc17
- [GHSA-fm8f-fq23-92xp]: GitHub (token and GitHub App) and GitLab (REST, GraphQL and archive downloads) credentials are
  no longer sent when a forge redirects a request to a different host or scheme. by @justaugustus in d7552fb3, and by
  @Sahana2524 in #5189
- [GHSA-h59x-jjpq-gr9p] and [GHSA-rvqc-48xm-qrmm]: attestor policy bypasses, resolved by removing `scorecard-attestor`.
  by @justaugustus in #5371

Also published: [GHSA-crhh-248m-2rm9], for this repository's `scdiff` CI workflow, fixed in 2024 by #4376. It needs no
action from users.

[GHSA-vphr-r3r5-mmfv]: https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/security/advisories/GHSA-vphr-r3r5-mmfv
[GHSA-6r4f-r463-fh56]: https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/security/advisories/GHSA-6r4f-r463-fh56
[GHSA-f6hq-fqq8-mjq8]: https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/security/advisories/GHSA-f6hq-fqq8-mjq8
[GHSA-fm8f-fq23-92xp]: https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/security/advisories/GHSA-fm8f-fq23-92xp
[GHSA-h59x-jjpq-gr9p]: https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/security/advisories/GHSA-h59x-jjpq-gr9p
[GHSA-rvqc-48xm-qrmm]: https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/security/advisories/GHSA-rvqc-48xm-qrmm
[GHSA-crhh-248m-2rm9]: https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/security/advisories/GHSA-crhh-248m-2rm9

## Score changes

### Branch-Protection

- A GitHub merge queue required by an active repository ruleset now satisfies "require branches to be up to date before
  merging". Scores can go up. by @osterman in #5281
- Azure DevOps: PR policies for default and named branches are mapped to branch protection, without counting unrelated
  push restrictions or unproven permissions. by @JamieMagee in #5340
- GitLab: a failed API request no longer stops the check, and a 401 or 403 from the external status checks API counts as
  no status checks instead of failing the check. by @vishnums2k5 in #5359

### Code-Review

- Azure DevOps: approvals use PR identity IDs and reviewer votes, and a missing identity no longer counts as an
  approval. Scores can go down. by @JamieMagee in #5325

### Dangerous-Workflow

- An unterminated `${{` expression in a workflow no longer aborts the check. by @Sahana2524 in #5177

### Maintained

- GitLab: each issue's author is checked separately. Before, one issue opened by a project member made every issue count
  as member activity, so some GitLab projects may score lower. by @vishnums2k5 in #5381

### Pinned-Dependencies

- Actions pinned to a tag of a GitHub immutable release count as pinned. Scores can go up. by @jessehouwing in #5248

### SAST

- References to LGTM.com, closed in 2022, have been removed. by @Kielek in #4985

### Signed-Releases

- A GitHub immutable release counts as signed, so projects that publish immutable releases can score higher. by
  @martincostello in #5002

### Vulnerabilities

- osv-scanner is updated to v2.7.1. Two upstream fixes drop false matches: Go standard library vulnerabilities on
  modules whose path ends in `/go`, and results from network-based plugins in offline mode. Scores can go up. by
  @justaugustus in #5475

## General

- With `--file-mode git`, a malformed or all-zero `--commit` fails with `invalid commit SHA` instead of silently
  scanning the default branch. by @cpanato in #5368
- `scorecard --help` documents the token environment variables, corrects the `--repo` and `--repos` formats, and sorts
  the `--checks` values. by @lasomethingsomething in #5430

### `scorecard mcp`

Fixes since the subcommand landed in #5402:

- `get_check_result` returns `missing_checks` and `complete` metadata. by @areeebs in #5418
- Repository references with an uppercase scheme or a trailing `.git` are accepted, `.` and `..` path segments are
  rejected, and GitLab subgroup paths are reported as unsupported. by @areeebs in #5419
- Commit SHAs are lowercased before querying published results, a missing result for a pinned commit is reported
  separately from a repository with no results, and results whose commit doesn't match the request are rejected. by
  @areeebs in #5420
- The experimental flag for each check comes from its definition. by @Muneer320 in #5421

## Docs

- :book: Document dependency, review, and advisory policies by @justaugustus in #5334
- :book: Document repository access and bug reporting by @justaugustus in #5335
- :book: Document architecture and privileged workflows, and script the `scdiff` comparison workflow by @justaugustus in
  #5336
- :book: Add a Gemara threat model for the scan engine by @justaugustus in #5337
- :book: Add the LF CRA stewardship statement and escalation policy by @justaugustus in #5369
- :book: Add [OpenSpec](https://openspec.dev/) specs for current behavior by @justaugustus in #5326
- :book: Retarget the OSPS Baseline coverage doc to `v2026.08.28` by @justaugustus in #5470
- :book: Fix broken doc links by @farisbasha in #5477
- :book: Drop flaky links from documentation by @justaugustus in #5480

## Other

- :seedling: Define each check's wiring once, in `internal/checkdef` (no behavior change) by @justaugustus in #5425,
  #5427, #5428, #5432, #5433, #5434, #5435, #5436, #5437, #5438, #5439, #5440, #5441
- :seedling: Replace issue templates with issue forms by @justaugustus in #5414
- :seedling: Publish OSPS Baseline results to [grc.store](https://grc.store/targets/scorecard/scorecard) by
  @justaugustus in #5338
- :seedling: Check doc links with lychee on PRs and weekly by @justaugustus in #5478
- :seedling: Turn off setup-go caching in scdiff and release workflows by @justaugustus in #5363
- :seedling: Bump golangci-lint tool to v2.15.0 by @cpanato in #5366
- :seedling: Bump ossf/scorecard-action to v2.5.0 by @justaugustus in #5313
- :seedling: Update e2e test for 10 open62541 vulnerabilities by @justaugustus in #5360

## Project

- We closed 165 issues filed before 2024 to refresh the tracker, and new issues now go through issue forms (#5414).
  Details are in the [issue cleanup discussion](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/discussions/5415).

## Known Issues

- **GitLab: Vulnerabilities returns −1 (inconclusive)** for GitLab repositories
  ([#5056](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/5056)).
- **Pinned-Dependencies: findings reached through a YAML alias point at the anchor's line**, not the alias
  ([#5291](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/5291)). Planned for v5.8.0.
- **Dangerous-Workflow misses some untrusted checkouts and `workflow_run` context fields**
  ([#5379](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/5379), [#5396](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/5396)).
- **CI-Tests and SAST can fail with an unrelated organization IP allow-list error** when recent commits carry
  third-party app check suites ([#5382](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/5382)).
- **CI-Tests and SAST can score lower when GitHub no longer returns older PR check data**
  ([#5411](https://github.com/ossf/scorecard/issues/5411)).
- **GitLab: Maintained reads only the first 20 issues and project members**, so large projects may score lower.

## New Contributors

- @osterman made their first contribution in #5281
- @jessehouwing made their first contribution in #5248
